de.abas.jfop.base.buffer

Interface LoadableBuffer

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BaseReadableBuffer, Buffer, DbObjectBuffer, MetadataSupport, ReadableBuffer
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    AddBuffer, LoadBuffer, LockableBuffer, SelectableBuffer, SelectBuffer

    public interface LoadableBuffer
extends Buffer, DbObjectBuffer
    Every FO buffer into which objects (database records) may be loaded implement this interface.

    • Method Detail

      • release

        boolean release()
         throws FOPException
        Releases the buffer contents.

        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are

        • german: 
          .HOLE, .LADE
        • english: 
          .SELECT, .LOAD

        Returns:
        true on success
        Throws:
        FOPException

      • isLoaded

        boolean isLoaded()
          throws FOPException
        Checks if this buffer has currently a record loaded.
        Technically this method just checks if the field "id" is defined in this buffer instance.
        Returns:
        True if a record is loaded.
        Throws:
        FOPException
